# A simple trash can with a filter for disposing of items and liquids.
***

**Recipes**

TrashCan

![trashcan](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b07fadaebf6f9d5821bbea6b73a8234448f29d7f.png)

Item Filter

![itemfilter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/12b1bf955dbece3925f246f693b85214b86694bf.png)

Liquid Filter

![liquidfilter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aa2523e70d26e7bc323a1fd96176d4ff37566593.png)

***

**Menus**

![trash](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f70f5aa13e635b7887916d86696da18048a540f2.png)

![filter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b25af16b8e84459cdded79a5a44c2283139f161.png)

***

This simple trash can mod adds a trash can, item filter and liquid filter, which allows you to place up to 54 items in the filter.
